makeFlxAnimateSprite.description: Creates a Lua Sprite that can use Animate Atlas.

parameters.folderOrImg: Path to image or atlas folder. Defaults to null.
parameters.animationJson: Path to animation JSON. Defaults to null.

loadAnimateAtlas.description: Loads the Atlas folder for a FlxAnimate sprite.

parameters.folderOrImg: Path to atlas folder or image.
parameters.animationJson: Path to animation JSON. Defaults to null.

addAnimationBySymbol.description: Adds an animation using a symbol from Adobe Animate.

parameters.name: Animation name to register.
parameters.symbol: Symbol identifier in the Animate file.
parameters.loop: Whether animation loops. Defaults to false.
